questions.q: To believers in which city is Romans written?
questions.evidence: to all who are in Rome, beloved of God, called to be saints: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ

questions.q: Paul says the Good News is the power of God for what?
questions.evidence: For I am not ashamed of the Good News of Christ, for it is the power of God for salvation for everyone who believes

questions.q: All have sinned, and fall short of what?
questions.evidence: for all have sinned, and fall short of the glory of God

questions.q: While we were still what, did Christ die for us?
questions.evidence: But God commends his own love toward us, in that while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us

questions.q: What are the wages of sin?
questions.evidence: For the wages of sin is death, but the free gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord

questions.q: All things work together for good for whom?
questions.evidence: We know that all things work together for good for those who love God, to those who are called according to his purpose

questions.q: Paul urges believers to present their bodies as what?
questions.evidence: Therefore I urge you, brothers, by the mercies of God, to present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable to God, which is your spiritual service

questions.q: What must you confess with your mouth, Romans 10 says?
questions.evidence: that if you will confess with your mouth that Jesus is Lord, and believe in your heart that God raised him from the dead, you will be saved
